BRIDGE는 LongMemEval-S 및 BEAM에서 이전 SOTA와 부트스트랩 CI 내에서 동등한 수준에 도달하고, 일치하는 리더에서 EverMemBench에서 최고의 메모리 기준선을 5.7-6.3점 능가합니다. 이 시스템은 쿼리당 약 5-7K 리더 프롬프트 토큰으로 실행되며, 각 수집 또는 쿼리에 대해 단일 LLM 호출을 사용합니다. 우리는 이러한 동등성이 그 자체로 결과라고 주장합니다. 표준 벤치마크는 메모리가 검색하는 것을 평가할 뿐, 에이전트가 행동할 때 메모리가 가능하게 하는 것을 평가하지 않습니다. 후자를 테스트하기 위해 우리는 교차 공급업체 검증 체인에 의해 생성 시점에 판단되는 5가지 적대적 프로브(규칙 적용 +/-, 패턴 유도 스타일/절차, 동적 다중 턴)를 도입합니다. 각 쿼리는 기억된 규칙이나 패턴을 적용해야만 해결될 수 있으며, 쿼리 자체는 이를 언급하지 않습니다. 5가지 프로브 x 20가지 시나리오 전반에 걸쳐 보편적으로 승리하는 아키텍처는 없습니다. 원자적 사실 추출기(LangMem)는 규칙 적용에서 승리하는 반면, BRIDGE의 블록-요약 메모리는 패턴 유도에서 승리합니다. 이 결과는 4개 도메인, 3개 채점자, 3개 리더 패밀리 전반에 걸쳐 유지됩니다. 각 디자인은 다른 디자인이 승리하는 곳에서 실패하며, 그 이유는 리콜 벤치마크가 볼 수 없는 이유 때문입니다. 원자적 사실 추출기는 시연된 패턴의 형식을 버리는 반면, 블록-요약 메모리는 규칙을 검색하지만 리더가 그에 따라 행동하지 않습니다. 규칙을 더 눈에 띄게 제시하면 이 간극이 크게 줄어듭니다. 메모리 디자인을 구분하는 것은 메모리가 검색하는 것이 아니라 에이전트가 무엇을 할 수 있도록 하는 것이며, 그것이 에이전트 메모리가 평가되어야 하는 기준입니다.
items.title_ko: 트렌치코트 속 RAG: 에이전트 시스템에 최소한의 메모리로 충분한 경우와 아닌 경우
items.summary_ko: 에이전트 메모리 연구에서 추출, 교체, 반영, 그래프 합성 등 RAG(검색 증강 생성) 위에 다양한 기법들이 축적되었지만, 이 연구에서는 그러한 기본 요소들이 테스트된 메모리 벤치마크에서 그 비용만큼의 가치를 거의 제공하지 못함을 보여줍니다. BRIDGE라는 최소한의 RAG 메모리만으로도 최신 기술과 동등하거나 더 나은 성능을 달성할 수 있음을 입증했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트 시스템에서 메모리 관리의 복잡성을 재평가하고, 필요한 최소한의 리소스로 최적의 성능을 얻는 방법에 대한 실용적인 통찰을 제공하여 개발 효율성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: CorrectCast: Selective Multimodal Context for Scale-Aware Residual Correction in Precipitation Nowcasting
items.body: Precipitation nowcasting models suffer from errors in intensity, location, and spatial structure. Addressing these errors by retraining nowcaster backbones can be computationally expensive and requires architecture-specific modifications. To overcome these limitations, we propose CorrectCast, a decoupled residual correction framework that refines completed nowcasts while keeping the base nowcaster frozen. By operating on predicted precipitation fields, CorrectCast requires training only a lightweight corrector, reducing computational overhead while providing a unified correction interface across different nowcasting models. Conditioned on the base nowcast and historical quantitative precipitation estimation (QPE) and precipitable water vapor (PWV) observations, the corrector selects multimodal context and employs scale-aware modulation to estimate residual corrections. On the Mississippi River Basin (MRB) and contiguous United States (CONUS) datasets, CorrectCast improves six base nowcasters spanning extrapolation-based, deterministic, and generative approaches, with absolute gains in mean CSI averaging 0.0233 and 0.0290 across the six models, respectively.
items.title_ko: CorrectCast: 강수 예측의 규모 인식 잔차 보정을 위한 선택적 다중 모달 컨텍스트
items.summary_ko: 강수 예측 모델의 강도, 위치, 공간 구조 오류를 해결하기 위해 'CorrectCast'라는 잔차 보정 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이 프레임워크는 기존 예측 모델을 고정하고 가벼운 보정 모델만 학습하여 효율적으로 예측을 개선합니다.
items.why_ko: 기존 예측 모델의 재학습 없이 성능을 개선하는 효율적인 방법을 제시하여, 날씨 예측과 같은 실시간 데이터 처리 시스템 개발에 유용할 수 있습니다.

items.title: The Only Edge Was Memorized in Training: LLM Trading Agents Around Earnings and Bad News
items.body: Large language model (LLM) trading agents are tested on news, but news reaches stock prices within minutes, and a benchmark that replays headlines at their publication time finds no alpha in trading on them. Money can then remain in two places, before news whose date is known, such as earnings announcements, and after bad news, if the market's fall went too far. However, studies of LLMs and earnings read documents published with or after the announcement, and studies of reversal sort monthly portfolios, so neither tells whether an agent can trade these moments after costs. In this paper, we test LLM agents at both moments on the same look-ahead-free benchmark, before 598 earnings announcements and after 409 bad-news drops of large US stocks. Every input is cut at the decision close, staged agents are compared with single calls, simple rules and a logistic regression, and every decision is made with and without the stock's name. Across five models from four vendors, no agent beat the simple bets. Before earnings, the agents mostly bought and earned what buying before every announcement earned, and after bad news, a Gemini-based agent called almost every fall an overreaction while no agent picked better dips than buying them all. The only gains came from what the models had memorized in training. Given only the ticker and the dates, a GPT-based model called the direction of 59.2% of the announcements before its training cutoff and 53.3% after it. Agent builders should therefore compare an event agent with the simple bet and test it blind after the training cutoff.
items.title_ko: LLM 트레이딩 에이전트의 유일한 이점은 훈련 시 기억된 정보뿐이다: 실적 발표 및 악재 분석
items.summary_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 기반 트레이딩 에이전트가 뉴스에 대해 테스트되지만, 뉴스 발표 후 단 몇 분 안에 주가에 반영되므로 실제 트레이딩에서 알파(초과 수익)를 창출하지 못한다는 연구 결과입니다. LLM이 실적 발표 및 악재에 대해 갖는 유일한 이점은 훈련 시 기억된 정보에 국한될 수 있음을 시사합니다.
items.why_ko: 금융 시장에서 LLM의 한계와 실제 적용 시 주의할 점을 명확히 보여주며, LLM 기반 금융 도구 개발 시 현실적인 기대를 갖도록 돕습니다.

items.title: Reconfiguring Procedural Knowledge for Compositional Robot Skill Adaptation
items.body: General-purpose behavior models increasingly internalize broad procedural knowledge during training, making their adaptation to new goals and skill interfaces less a problem of learning entirely new behaviors than of reconfiguring existing competence. We study this capability as reconfigurability, the ability to realize new behaviors by cost-efficiently restructuring existing components and relations under sparse governing information, where task specifications provide high-level goals and procedure specifications expose a limited set of reusable factors, leaving the concrete bindings and compositions required for execution underdetermined. We propose RecPo, a framework that represents skills task-agnostically through multiple procedure views and materializes executable skill sequences by composing stored transitions to realize task-specific changes. RecPo maintains a procedure knowledge base of skill-induced transitions, with each view exposing a reusable factor and preserving local skill connectivity. At deployment, it interprets task specifications through the same views and resolves the resulting compositional queries over the stored relations to bind skills for execution. On long-horizon tasks in an extended Franka Kitchen benchmark, RecPo achieves 91.9% ordered completion with 1.0 ms of task inference per episode across varying procedure support and task-record sparsity. Real-robot studies further demonstrate adaptation through local memory edits without task-specific retraining.
items.title_ko: 구성 로봇 기술 적응을 위한 절차 지식 재구성
items.summary_ko: 일반 목적 행동 모델이 훈련 중 광범위한 절차 지식을 내재화하면서, 새로운 목표와 스킬 인터페이스에 대한 적응이 전적으로 새로운 행동을 학습하는 것보다 기존 역량을 재구성하는 문제에 가까워지고 있음을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇이 새로운 작업을 학습할 때 기존 지식을 효율적으로 재활용하는 방법을 제시하여, 로봇의 유연성과 적응성을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Towards Optimism-Pessimism Trade-off in Model-based Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Model-based offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) enables sample-efficient adaptation by leveraging offline pre-training for online fine-tuning. However, the distribution shifts between offline and online stages often hinder fine-tuning performance. Many existing methods encode the optimism-pessimism trade-off through a single-objective formulation. Selecting its trade-off coefficient through online fine-tuning can require costly bi-level optimization. We identify the balance established during offline training as a key challenge: in our motivating experiments, optimistic policies adapt better to novel tasks, whereas pessimistic policies perform better on the same online tasks. To address this challenge, we propose a bi-objective formulation that captures this trade-off, yielding a Pareto policy pool during offline training. This policy pool enables adaptive selection during online fine-tuning across diverse online tasks. To generate the pool, we introduce Multi-Objective Soft Actor-critIC (MOSAIC), which solves bi-objective problems and constructs diverse Pareto policies. After offline training, a contextual bandit algorithm hierarchically selects the most suitable policy for fine-tuning at each online interaction step. Empirically, our pipeline, Hierarchical Pareto Policy Pool (HiP3), achieves the strongest aggregate performance across both same and novel online tasks and maintains its advantage under stronger distribution shifts. Comprehensive ablations further clarify the roles of the policy pool, MOSAIC-based pool construction, and the online selection mechanism.
items.title_ko: 모델 기반 오프라인-온라인 강화 학습의 낙관주의-비관주의 균형 탐색
items.summary_ko: 모델 기반 오프라인-온라인 강화 학습(RL)에서 오프라인 사전 학습과 온라인 파인튜닝 간의 분포 변화가 성능을 저해하는 문제를 다룹니다. 낙관주의-비관주의 균형을 다루는 기존 방법론의 한계를 지적하고, 비용이 많이 드는 이중 수준 최적화 없이 균형을 잡는 방법을 모색합니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습에서 오프라인-온라인 학습 간의 효율적인 전환과 안정적인 성능 확보를 위한 중요한 연구로, 실제 환경에 적용되는 RL 시스템 개발에 필수적입니다.

items.title: Readie: Low-Latency Code Sandboxes for AI Agents
items.body:
From quantitative research to personal assistance, AI agents act by iteratively generating and executing code. To decouple the agent harness from code execution, many agents offload execution to dedicated systems called code sandboxes. However, existing code sandboxes suffer from slow startup. Whether they rely on custom snapshots or a single fat image, the root cause is the same: it is hard to build a compact, pre-warmed snapshot that can be shared across diverse agent-generated code while covering nearly all the artifacts (e.g., packages, datasets) it requires.
In this work, we propose learned startup snapshots for low-latency code sandboxes. Our insight is that while it is hard for a single snapshot to be both compact and cover most workloads, a set of snapshots can achieve both. Each snapshot is small, initializes quickly, and covers a fraction of agent-generated code; together, the set covers most of it. We learn this set from a large training workload by formulating snapshot construction as an optimization problem and solving it with an approximation algorithm. Planned on 15K public and LLM-synthesized scripts, our system, Readie, reduces startup latency by 3-22$\times$ and end-to-end runtime by 1.3-3.3$\times$ compared to existing approaches at the same storage budget.

items.title: Not All Evidence Is Admissible: Evidence Governance for Tool-Augmented Medical Agents
items.body: Tool-augmented medical agents treat whatever their tools return as evidence. We show that this default is costly: medical tools fail silently, and a frozen reasoner cannot ignore what enters its context, so many cases it would have answered correctly are flipped to wrong once tool outputs are added. We call this evidence hijacking. $\mathcal{V}$-information explains the phenomenon: the reasoner has lost the option to ignore, so a tool output can carry negative usable information, and moving the decision of what to keep outside the reasoner restores that option. The theory further shows that part of any filtering gain comes merely from letting the reasoner see less, and only selection by content lets it see better. Building on this, we recast tool-augmented reasoning as evidence governance, which separates deciding what counts as evidence from the reasoner that answers, and propose context-independent evidence governance (CIEG), the first medical agent framework that rules, after acquisition, on whether each individual tool output may enter as evidence. Every tool output is written as a card that can be checked against the raw input; an independent checker that sees only the input and the cards decides which cards become evidence; and the reasoner answers from the admitted cards alone, with no training anywhere. On medical question answering, fundus glaucoma screening, and chest X-ray pneumonia classification, it achieves the highest accuracy among models of comparable scale, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art tool-using agents and multi-agent systems built on the same backbone at lower cost.
items.title_ko: 모든 증거가 허용되는 것은 아니다: 도구 증강 의료 에이전트를 위한 증거 거버넌스
items.summary_ko: 도구 증강 의료 에이전트가 도구에서 반환된 모든 정보를 증거로 취급하는 기본 방식의 문제점을 지적합니다. 잘못된 도구 출력으로 인해 에이전트의 정확한 판단이 왜곡되는 '증거 하이재킹' 현상을 설명합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI와 같이 민감한 분야에서 AI 에이전트의 의사결정 신뢰성을 높이기 위한 중요한 연구입니다. 도구 사용 시 증거의 유효성을 판단하는 메커니즘 개발에 필요합니다.

items.title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
items.body: We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rules before acting, the coding adapter writes its own test or scratch files on SWE-bench Pro V2, the constraints adapter carries earlier turns into its answers, the chart adapter measures the marks in code, and the document adapter reads AutomationBench's spreadsheets.
items.title_ko: 전문가가 구축한 태스크에 대한 RL이 Nemotron 3.5 Super에 가르치는 것
items.summary_ko: NVIDIA의 Nemotron 3.5 Super 모델을 실제 소프트웨어 엔지니어링, 복잡한 제약 조건, 장기 도구 사용 등 전문가가 구축한 5가지 태스크 데이터셋에 대해 강화 학습(RL)으로 후속 학습했습니다. 각 태스크별 LoRA 어댑터는 기본 모델과 비교하여 성능 향상을 보였습니다.
items.why_ko: 특정 전문 분야에서 LLM의 성능을 RL을 통해 효과적으로 미세 조정하는 방법을 보여주며, 산업별 특화된 AI 모델 개발에 중요한 실마리를 제공합니다.

items.title: Centroid Spectral Coupling: Implicit Alignment and Representation Diversity in Self-Supervised Learning
items.body: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) aims to align augmented views while preserving representation diversity and preventing collapse. Existing non-contrastive methods often address these goals using multiple weighted loss terms. We introduce Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC), a single-term SSL objective that implicitly couples view alignment, representation diversity, and collapse resistance. CSC constructs centroids from independently normalized augmented-view pairs and applies a ridge-based spectral objective to their uncentered second-moment matrix. Preserving centroid magnitudes encodes view agreement while encouraging balanced representation energy across spectral directions. We establish an exact decomposition into nonnegative alignment and spectral-imbalance components, characterize the geometry of global optima, and derive finite-loss guarantees for alignment and diversity. We also show that complete constant-output collapse is a strict saddle in normalized representation space. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Imagenette show that CSC achieves the highest linear Top-1 accuracy among the evaluated non-contrastive methods on all three benchmarks, and the highest kNN Top-1 accuracy on both CIFAR datasets. A ridge-parameter sensitivity study reveals an empirical alignment--diversity trade-off: increasing $κ$ strengthens view alignment but reduces representation effective rank. These results show that a unified spectral objective yields competitive visual representations without explicit contrastive negatives or separately weighted alignment and diversity penalties.
items.title_ko: Centroid Spectral Coupling: 자기 지도 학습에서 암묵적 정렬 및 표현 다양성
items.summary_ko: 자기 지도 학습(SSL)에서 뷰 정렬, 표현 다양성 유지, 붕괴 방지라는 세 가지 목표를 단일 손실 함수로 해결하는 'Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC)'을 제안합니다. CSC는 중심점 스펙트럼 커플링을 통해 이 목표들을 암묵적으로 달성합니다.
items.why_ko: 자기 지도 학습의 효율성과 안정성을 높이는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 대규모 비지도 학습 모델 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: EgoHandWAM: Probing the Role of Hand Motion in Egocentric World Action Modeling
items.body: How much does hand motion tell us about what a first-person camera will see next? EgoHandWAM forecasts three-dimensional wrist and fingertip trajectories and a future visual feature from the current image and recent hand states. We train on 751,065 EgoDex windows using a frozen DINOv2 encoder. On held-out development sessions, the action-only model reduces two-second wrist endpoint error from 60.26 to 56.48~mm relative to a stationary forecast. It still underestimates long reaches. Adding future-feature supervision gives nearly identical trajectory accuracy. With the recorded hand history, the visual head reduces smooth L1 error by 1.32\% relative to copying the current feature. Shuffling histories across sessions erases this gain. In a separate four-task probe, adding recorded future displacements to observed context and future tracking-validity masks reduces visual-feature error by 3.93\%. Masks alone give little improvement. A trajectory predicted from the same observations adds little. On two simulated RoboTwin tasks, substituting aligned human examples for an auxiliary batch of robot examples gives no consistent increase in task success across three training seeds.
items.title_ko: EgoHandWAM: 자기중심적 세계 행동 모델링에서 손 움직임의 역할 탐색
items.summary_ko: EgoHandWAM은 현재 이미지와 최근 손 상태를 기반으로 3D 손목 및 손가락 끝 궤적과 미래 시각 특징을 예측하여, 자기중심적 관점에서 손 움직임이 향후 시각 정보 예측에 얼마나 기여하는지 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇이 인간의 행동을 예측하고 상호작용하는 데 필요한 손 움직임 분석 기술의 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
items.body: Open-weight language models are widely observed to get worse the longer they generate. Often, attempts to fix this involve more training. At high temperature, The sampler, i.e. the rule that picks the next token out of the model's probabilities, decides whether long and agentic generation survives and/or thrives. We test 29 open-weight models from 1B to 122B parameters on ten established benchmarks plus needle retrieval out to one million tokens, covering SWE-bench Verified coding agents, long chain-of-thought reasoning, long-form writing, long structured output and long-context reading. Samplers that keep their pool of candidate tokens small and steady as temperature rises don't lose accuracy. Samplers that let in low-probability tokens fall apart. At temperature 2, coding agents running top-p, top-k or Top-H resolve 0 of 100 GitHub issues, while the same agents running top-nsigma resolve 46 to 62 and win every issue the two samplers disagree on, on three Qwen3.5 models. Over all benchmarks top-nsigma keeps a median 100% of its temperature-1 score where top-p keeps 26%. Counting how many tokens each sampler lets through explains why. In one Llama-3.1-8B story, going from temperature 1 to 2 grows top-p's pool from 4 tokens to 51,845 while top-nsigma stays at 3. Across 133 combinations of sampler setting and temperature, the typical pool size predicts judged quality (Spearman correlation of -0.77), and when we pick the pool at temperature 1 and only apply temperature afterwards, Top-H, min-p and p-less stop collapsing. At the default temperature of 1 most samplers perform about the same, We release all code and data to the public.
items.title_ko: 장문 생성은 샘플링 문제이다 (온도를 높이면)
items.summary_ko: 오픈 소스 언어 모델이 길게 생성할수록 성능이 저하되는 현상을 연구합니다. 특히 높은 온도(temperature)에서 샘플러가 장문 및 에이전트 생성의 성공 여부를 결정하며, 기존의 많은 연구가 훈련에 집중했지만 샘플링 기법 개선이 더 중요할 수 있음을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 장문 생성 품질을 향상시키기 위한 새로운 관점을 제시하며, 모델의 샘플링 전략 최적화에 대한 실무적 중요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: When does deep reinforcement learning pay off in HVAC supervisory control? Four small Modelica case studies trained directly on FMUs
items.body:
Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is often proposed for the supervisory control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems. The reported gains are, however, difficult to interpret, because the baselines are often weak and the attainable optimum is seldom known. This paper examines four small, reproducible case studies based on an office building in Brisbane, Australia: pre-cooling under a time-of-use tariff; chiller staging with condenser water reset; chilled water supply temperature reset with a wet cooling coil; and chilled water storage under time-of-use prices and a demand charge. The plants were modelled with the Modelica Buildings library, and in three of the cases a soft actor-critic agent was trained directly on the exported functional mock-up unit (FMU). Each agent was compared with tuned rule-based controllers and, where practicable, with a near-optimal reference from hourly exhaustive search or dynamic programming with perfect foresight.
In the two cases without storage the agent reached the near-optimal reference, but the margin above a well-chosen rule was small: 1.3% for condenser water reset and 0.18% for chilled water reset. In the latter case two common reset rules consumed more energy than a fixed set point. With a chilled water storage tank the margin was considerably larger. The agent outperformed both rules (-7.8%, compared with -3.9% and -6.3%) and adopted midday charging during the solar off-peak period, yet it obtained only about 45% of the saving achieved by the perfect-foresight schedule and did little to limit the demand peak. In the pre-cooling case a hand-tuned rule remained superior (-12.0% compared with -5.6%). These results suggest that studies of DRL for HVAC control should state the margin between the best rule and a near-optimal reference. Some practical difficulties encountered in training on co-simulation FMUs are also reported.
items.title_ko: HVAC 제어에서 심층 강화 학습의 이점: Modelica 사례 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 HVAC(난방, 환기, 공조) 시스템의 감독 제어에 심층 강화 학습(DRL)을 적용했을 때의 이점을 네 가지 Modelica 기반 사례 연구를 통해 분석합니다. DRL의 이점이 약한 기준선 때문에 과장될 수 있음을 지적합니다.
items.why_ko: 실제 시스템 제어에 DRL을 적용할 때의 장단점과 평가의 중요성을 다루며, 실제 산업 적용 시 고려해야 할 사항을 제시합니다.

items.title: Synthetic Crystal Data Generation for Diffusion Pretraining in Material Property Prediction
items.body: Diffusion-based pretraining has emerged as a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations in graph neural networks for materials property prediction without requiring quantum-mechanical labels such as energies, forces, and stresses for every pretraining structure. However, the method retains a critical dependency: it requires structures residing near local minima of a potential energy surface, which have traditionally been obtained through costly DFT relaxations of known or physically synthesized compounds. This reliance constrains both the scale and the structural diversity of available pretraining data, leaving large regions of crystal structure space unexplored. In this work, we connect diffusion-based pretraining with synthetic structure generation to reduce this bottleneck. We introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies: perturb-and-relax, generative sampling via MatterGen, and protostructure enumeration. Where structural relaxation is required, we use fast machine-learned interatomic potentials instead of performing a new DFT relaxation for each generated structure. We further compare a coordinate-denoising control with continuous-time variance-preserving (VP) and sub-VP diffusion objectives using a randomly initialized Orb-v2 backbone. The source comparison covers seven MatBench property-prediction tasks, and an eighth task, \texttt{mp\_gap}, is included in the protostructure scaling study. Every synthetic-pretraining condition numerically outperforms random initialization on all seven source-comparison tasks. Scaling the protostructure corpus from 20k to 165k under a fixed 400-epoch schedule numerically matches or exceeds MP-20k pretraining on most tasks; because this protocol increases both data diversity and optimization updates, the result reflects joint data-and-compute scaling.
items.title_ko: 재료 특성 예측을 위한 확산 사전 학습에서의 합성 결정 데이터 생성
items.summary_ko: 재료 특성 예측을 위한 그래프 신경망에서 전이 가능한 표현을 학습하기 위한 확산 기반 사전 학습 전략을 연구합니다. 이 방법은 양자 역학적 레이블 없이도 합성 결정 구조를 생성하여 데이터 의존성을 줄이는 데 초점을 맞춥니다.
items.why_ko: 재료 과학 분야에서 데이터 부족 문제를 해결하고, 새로운 물질 발견을 가속화할 수 있는 AI 기반 접근 방식을 제시합니다.

items.title: RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time
items.body: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.
items.body_ko: 멀티모달 에이전트는 이제 도구를 호출하고 코드를 작성하여 로봇 팔을 제어할 수 있습니다. 기존 벤치마크는 세 가지 측면에서 부족합니다. 대부분은 짧은 작업에서 한두 개의 팔을 테스트하고, 에이전트가 생각하는 동안 세계를 일시 정지하는 경우가 많으며, 많은 경우 지상 진실 객체 위치를 제공합니다. 우리는 에이전트가 카메라 이미지만을 사용하여 4개에서 16개의 로봇 팔을 실시간으로 제어하는 시뮬레이션 벤치마크인 RoboTeam을 제시합니다. 36가지 작업은 팔이 함께 수행해야 하는 긴 작업으로, 예를 들어 목재를 전달하거나 수백 개의 큐브로 그림을 만드는 것과 같습니다. 우리는 가장 유연한 에이전트 시스템인 적응형 시스템에서 시작합니다. 이 시스템에서는 하나의 에이전트가 대리인을 분기할 시기를 결정합니다. 이 시스템을 통해 gpt-6.1-sol과 opus-5.5는 각각 28개와 27개의 작업을 완료했으며, 다른 4개 모델은 최대 3개만 완료했습니다. 그러나 높은 비용이 따릅니다. gpt-6.1-sol은 일반적인 작업을 완료하는 데 3.5시간과 2억 1,800만 개의 입력 토큰이 필요하며, 단계의 3분의 1은 적어도 한 번 실패하여 재시도해야 합니다. 그런 다음 단일 에이전트, 계층적, 분산형의 세 가지 고정 시스템과 비교합니다. 네 시스템 모두 유사한 수의 작업을 완료하지만 시간과 토큰에서 차이가 있습니다. 계층적 및 분산형 시스템은 더 빠르지만 최대 1.9배의 토큰을 사용하고, 단일 에이전트는 더 적은 토큰을 사용하지만 1.6배 더 오래 걸리므로 적응형 시스템은 그 중간에 있습니다. 그럼에도 불구하고 아직 빠르고 저렴하며 신뢰할 수 있는 모델이나 시스템은 없습니다. RoboTeam은 이전 벤치마크가 측정할 수 없었던 이러한 한계를 측정합니다. 즉, 긴 다중 팔 작업, 카메라 이미지 전용, 그리고 결코 멈추지 않는 세계를 다룹니다.
items.title_ko: RoboTeam: 실시간 다중 로봇 팔 비전 기반 제어 벤치마킹
items.summary_ko: RoboTeam은 카메라 이미지만으로 4개에서 16개의 로봇 팔을 실시간으로 제어하는 시뮬레이션 벤치마크입니다. 기존 벤치마크의 한계(소수의 로봇, 일시 정지된 세계, 그라운드 트루스 위치 제공 등)를 극복하고, 여러 로봇이 협력하여 복잡한 작업을 수행하는 36가지 태스크를 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 다중 로봇 시스템의 실시간 비전 기반 제어 능력을 평가하는 새로운 벤치마크로, 복잡한 로봇 협업 시스템 개발에 중요한 이정표가 될 것입니다.

items.title: Big Brains, Tiny Board: Pupavision, an Agentic Physical AI Instrument for Monitoring Drosophila Pupariation and Lifecycle Transitions
items.body: Many biology experiments are limited by the availability and ease of use of instruments that monitor and record them. For example, the timing of pupariation in the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster, a widely used model organism, can provide biologically relevant information about growth regulation and is often recorded manually. Here, we present Pupavision, a small physical AI instrument built from a single-board Linux computer and a day/night camera for roughly 45 to 75 US dollars in parts. The key idea is that a frontier coding agent runs its agentic harness directly on the tiny board. The model thinks in the cloud, but the agent works on the device. The agent assists image capture, writes code to repair errors, and checks the experiment every day to keep raw data capture reliable. If recording stops, the researcher gets a ping on their mobile phone. A simple deterministic capture service records one image every ten minutes and never depends on the agent. We report a 26-day pilot in a fly incubator (about 3,580 frames), including eleven days in which the agent was logged out and capture continued, and a 51-hour outage whose cause led to the layered design. A researcher-in-the-loop workflow then produces per-vial pupariation curves by tracing selected pupae backward in time from a late reference frame. Future work will validate the assay for lifecycle tracking accuracy against expert-labeled data and expand real-time computer vision analysis. Pupavision offers a blueprint for do-it-yourself agentic instruments that put frontier intelligence on a tiny board, with deterministic code underneath. We present this as an early case study from a pilot lab deployment and contribute lessons learned toward a future where scientific domain experts are empowered by DIY agentic hardware.
items.title_ko: Big Brains, Tiny Board: Drosophila 번데기화 및 생애 주기 모니터링을 위한 에이전트 기반 물리 AI 기기, Pupavision
items.summary_ko: Pupavision은 단일 보드 리눅스 컴퓨터와 주야간 카메라로 약 45~75달러의 비용으로 구축된 소형 물리 AI 기기입니다. 이 기기는 초파리의 번데기화 시기와 생애 주기 전환을 모니터링하고 기록하여 생물학 실험의 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: 저비용 하드웨어와 AI를 결합하여 생물학 연구의 자동화를 혁신하는 사례입니다. 임베디드 AI 및 에이전트 시스템 개발자들에게 실용적인 아이디어를 제공합니다.

items.title: ReMoE: An Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Human Mobility Recovery Forecasting Across Disasters
items.body: Human mobility often declines sharply following disasters and subsequently exhibits complex recovery dynamics. Effective forecasting of this recovery is critical for timely assessment and resource allocation. However, existing approaches are often developed for individual events and operate as black boxes, limiting their transferability and interpretability beyond the events they were trained on. Recent studies have identified recurring post-disaster mobility recovery types across disasters, suggesting that recovery knowledge may be transferable. Motivated by this, we propose ReMoE, an interpretable mixture-of-experts framework for cross-disaster mobility recovery forecasting. ReMoE uses a feature-guided router to adaptively combine specialized experts that learn these heterogeneous yet reusable recovery types, producing a region-specific recovery pattern. It further refines this pattern through residual correction informed by forecasts of future hazard conditions. We evaluate ReMoE on a large-scale mobility dataset covering 18 disaster events spanning hurricanes, floods, winter storms, and wildfires. ReMoE is competitive in-distribution and achieves the strongest performance on unseen events and hazard types, with larger gains under greater distribution shifts. Further analyses show that ReMoE yields interpretable learning outcomes and maintains robust performance under uncertainty. Broadly, ReMoE offers a transferable and traceable forecaster that can support anticipatory post-disaster assessment.
items.title_ko: ReMoE: 재난 시 인간 이동성 회복 예측을 위한 해석 가능한 혼합 전문가 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 재난 발생 후 급격히 감소하고 복잡한 회복 동역학을 보이는 인간 이동성을 효과적으로 예측하기 위한 'ReMoE' 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이 프레임워크는 기존 블랙박스 모델의 한계를 극복하고 예측의 전이성과 해석 가능성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: 재난 관리 및 도시 계획 분야에서 AI 기반의 이동성 예측 모델의 해석 가능성을 높여, 정책 결정자들이 예측 결과를 신뢰하고 활용할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

items.title: LoCaR: Localized Canvas Retrieval With Frozen Vision-Language Model
items.body: Whole image embeddings can under represent small objects and local attributes that distinguish relevant images for localized queries. We present LoCaR, a training free framework for localized text to image retrieval with frozen vision language models. LoCaR constructs and utilizes independent proposals (SAM2) focusing on the object so as to get a more localized representation that independently encodes each region using the frozen visual encoder. We further study paired-support adaptation as an optional residual that uses matched text region exemplars without updating the underlying encoders. We also introduce LOCFG, a Visual Genome derived benchmark designed to evaluate localized retrieval for smaller and more challenging referents. Across several vision language backbones, our results show that improving the region representation itself is the main source of gain.
items.title_ko: LoCaR: Frozen VLM을 이용한 지역화된 캔버스 검색
items.summary_ko: LoCaR(Localized Canvas Retrieval)은 전체 이미지 임베딩이 작은 객체나 지역적 특성을 충분히 반영하지 못하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 제안된 훈련 없는 프레임워크입니다. 이는 SAM2 제안을 사용하여 객체에 초점을 맞추고 동결된 시각 인코더로 각 영역을 독립적으로 인코딩합니다.
items.why_ko: 지역화된 이미지 검색의 정확도를 높이는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 이미지 콘텐츠 이해 및 검색 시스템 개발에 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Bandit Online Submodular Minimisation Using Zeroth-Order Oracles
items.body: We consider online submodular minimisation under bandit feedback, where at each round a decision maker plays a subset and observes only its cost, while the cost functions, and hence their minimiser, change over time. Existing bandit methods only guarantee static regret, which compares against a single fixed subset and is a weak benchmark when the minimiser moves. This paper provides, to the best of our knowledge, the first method with guarantees for tracking a moving minimiser in this setting. We propose a zeroth-order method built on a two-point oracle for the Lovász extension whose two evaluations are both subsets that can be played. The perturbed and base points are rounded by a common random threshold, and drawing the smoothing direction from the unit sphere makes the base evaluation a zero-mean control variate, so the oracle is an unbiased estimator of the smoothed gradient. We establish dynamic regret bounds of order $O\big((1+\sqrt{P^\ast_N})N^{3/4}\big)$ in general and $O\big((1+\sqrt{P^\ast_N})N^{2/3}\big)$ under a sufficiently small drift, where $P^\ast_N$ is the path length of the minimiser sequence, together with the corresponding $O(N^{3/4})$ and $O(N^{2/3})$ static regret bounds. Numerically, the method attains lower regret than the algorithm of (Hazan and Kale (2012)), with the advantage growing with the path length.
items.title_ko: 제로 차수 오라클을 이용한 밴딧 온라인 준모듈러 최소화
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 밴딧 피드백 하의 온라인 준모듈러 최소화 문제를 다룹니다. 비용 함수와 최소화자가 시간에 따라 변할 때, 이동하는 최소화자를 추적하기 위한 새로운 방법을 제시하며, 정적 후회(static regret)보다 강력한 성능 보장을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 동적으로 변화하는 환경에서 최적의 결정을 내리는 온라인 최적화 문제에 대한 이론적 기여를 합니다.

items.title: TempQuant: Learning Adaptive Temperatures for Quantized Language Models
items.body: Large language models are increasingly deployed at low precision, yet quantization can degrade their performance. We study how quantization interacts with decoding settings such as the sampling temperature and top-p by examining how it distorts the model's next-token probabilities. Measuring entropy during generation across deployed temperatures, we find that quantization warms the model on average, and that temperature matters much more for the performance of a quantized model than for its full-precision counterpart. Because quantization and temperature both shape the next-token distribution, we investigate how much the sampling settings can undo what quantization changes, through our method TempQuant, which learns the quantized model's temperature and top-p to bring its next-token probabilities closer to the full-precision model's. We learn these settings at two granularities. The first is a single global setting per requested temperature, which finds nearly the same temperatures that tuning on labeled answers would, without any labels. Model cards typically recommend sampling a quantized model with the same settings as its full-precision counterpart, while we find that different settings can substantially improve its accuracy. On 3-bit Qwen3-4B, for example, global TempQuant raises MATH accuracy from 34% under the configuration recommended for Qwen's quantized releases to 51%. The second sets the temperature and top-p for every token, motivated by our finding that tokens whose rankings flip under quantization tend to need warming, while tokens whose rankings are preserved tend to need cooling. When quantization degrades accuracy substantially, TempQuant recovers much of it, and when degradation is lighter, it still brings the quantized model's behavior closer to the full-precision model's.
items.title_ko: TempQuant: 양자화된 언어 모델을 위한 적응형 온도 학습
items.summary_ko: 양자화된 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)에서 성능 저하를 줄이기 위해 샘플링 온도와 top-p와 같은 디코딩 설정이 양자화와 어떻게 상호 작용하는지 연구합니다. 양자화가 모델을 평균적으로 '따뜻하게' 만들며, 양자화된 모델의 성능에는 온도가 훨씬 더 중요함을 발견했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 양자화 시 성능 저하를 완화하고 최적의 추론 결과를 얻기 위한 중요한 실무적 팁을 제공합니다. 개발자들은 이를 통해 양자화된 모델의 디코딩 전략을 최적화할 수 있습니다.

items.title: What MoE Routing Controls: Causal Interventions on Expert Trajectories
items.body: In mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, a token is routed to a sequence of experts across layers. We investigate how forcing tokens onto chosen expert paths influences model behavior. We build a target path from the experts that a concept's or role's tokens most often use, and we add a fixed bias to each target expert's router logit during generation to steer the token toward this expert path. We study two kinds of targets. Format targets concern the form of the output, and concept targets concern its topic. In Qwen3-30B-A3B, we show that steering a format path changes the text the model writes. We also show that steering a concept path shifts the model's next-token probabilities toward the concept, even when the path is built in another language, yet this shift has little effect on the generated text. We investigate why formats reach the text but concepts do not by steering only part of the generation, and find evidence that a format, once started, reinforces itself. We show that the concepts religion and money steer most strongly, and that the effect is concentrated in the middle layers. We attempt to explain why the strength of the effect varies by concept through an analysis of embedding distinctiveness and word frequency.
items.title_ko: MoE 라우팅 제어 대상: 전문가 궤적에 대한 인과적 개입
items.summary_ko: MoE(혼합 전문가) 언어 모델에서 토큰이 레이어를 가로질러 선택된 전문가 시퀀스로 라우팅될 때, 토큰을 특정 전문가 경로로 강제할 경우 모델 행동에 어떤 영향을 미 미치는지 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: MoE 모델의 내부 작동 방식을 이해하고 특정 행동을 유도하기 위한 제어 메커니즘을 탐구하는 연구입니다.

items.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.body: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent workloads.
items.title_ko: TeleChat에서 Xing4로: 국내 칩 및 프레임워크에서 최첨단 에이전트 모델 발전
items.summary_ko: Xing 4는 Ascend 플랫폼에서 모델 아키텍처와 훈련 인프라의 조화로운 발전을 통해 TeleChat 계보를 확장하는 대규모 언어 모델 시리즈입니다. 희소 활성화, 어텐션 설계, 모델 깊이 및 너비, 추측 디코딩이 모델 용량과 계산량의 균형을 어떻게 맞추는지 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 특정 하드웨어 아키텍처(Ascend)에 최적화된 LLM 개발 사례를 보여주며, 하드웨어와 소프트웨어의 통합 최적화가 모델 성능에 미치는 영향을 이해하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
items.body: Language agents rely on long-term memory to personalize responses across extended interactions, yet stored facts quietly go stale as the world changes, and an agent often learns that using memory hurt only through delayed feedback after acting on an outdated record. Before the memory store is updated, how far should that negative feedback propagate: should it suppress memory use only on future queries for that same fact (a local policy), or also across other stored facts (a global policy)? Existing memory systems implicitly fix one of these two sharing scopes at design time. We formulate this online scope choice under hidden validity and delayed feedback as memory conflict governance, and prove that neither fixed policy is sufficient on its own. We then propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that retains both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them online without retraining the LLM. Using revealed comparisons between answering with memory and answering without memory (the no-memory anchor), a Local Advisor tracks the latest outcome on the queried fact alone, while a Global Advisor pools recent outcomes across all stored facts. A Meta Governor follows the Local Advisor by default to avoid cross-fact interference and switches to the Global Advisor only when global pooling accumulates a strictly positive recent utility margin, guaranteeing finite-time switching under delayed feedback. Across LongMemEval update streams and real-world historical drift on TempLAMA and TAQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o, RegimeCouncil outperforms the better fixed-scope policy by 5.2-7.3 points on primary disagreement episodes and across all 30 held-out settings, while ablations show that removing any of its three modules reduces accuracy by 2-7 points.
items.title_ko: RegimeCouncil: LLM 에이전트의 메모리 충돌 거버넌스를 위한 증거 기반 라우팅
items.summary_ko: 언어 에이전트가 장기 기억을 사용하여 상호작용을 개인화할 때, 저장된 사실이 시간이 지나면서 구식이 될 수 있는 문제점을 다룹니다. 메모리 사용이 부정적인 영향을 미쳤을 때, 이러한 피드백이 얼마나 광범위하게 전파되어야 하는지에 대한 정책을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트의 장기 기억 관리 및 최신 정보 유지 전략에 대한 중요한 연구입니다. 에이전트의 신뢰성과 적응성을 높이는 데 필수적인 기술입니다.

items.title: VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models
items.body: Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%. Physical-feature analysis links powertrain recognition to deceleration behaviour and size recognition to steering response. Errors near size-class boundaries and limited gains from longer observations highlight the importance of label resolution and training-fleet coverage for cross-model generalisation.
items.title_ko: VTT: 미지의 자동차 모델에서 움직임 궤적으로 차량 크기 및 파워트레인 유형 읽기
items.summary_ko: VTT는 움직임 궤적과 CAN(Controller Area Network) 신호를 통해 미지의 자동차 모델의 차량 크기와 파워트레인 속성을 식별하기 위한 데이터셋 및 벤치마크입니다. 이는 교통 분석 및 시뮬레이션을 위한 궤적 데이터를 풍부하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 교통 분석 및 자율주행 분야에서 차량 속성 인식을 위한 새로운 데이터셋과 방법을 제시합니다. AI 기반 스마트 교통 시스템 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: From Sorry to QED: Refining LLM Math Proofs via Angelic Execution
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) can now generate Lean proof scripts that capture the high-level structure of many mathematical arguments. However, these scripts frequently fail on complex theorems: a single missing side condition or misapplied lemma can cause the prover to abort early and discard an otherwise viable proof outline. This paper presents MathEye, a framework that converts imperfect LLM-generated proof scripts into fully verified Lean proofs by combining symbolic reasoning with minimal human interaction. At the core of MathEye is angelic proof checking, an optimistic execution model that replaces failing proof fragments with placeholders while preserving the overall structure of the argument. This optimistic check produces an angelic proof that isolates the exact proof obligations that the LLM fails to discharge. Because these unresolved obligations are often logically interdependent, asking a mathematician to address every placeholder directly is inefficient. To minimize human effort, MathEye performs residual analysis over a proof dependence graph that captures symbol-level data flow in the angelic proof. By formulating obligation selection as a MaxSAT optimization problem, MathEye selects a minimal-cost set of essential obligations whose resolution suffices to complete the entire proof. MathEye presents these essential obligations to the mathematician in ordinary mathematical language and uses the mathematician's answers to automatically reconstruct the complete Lean proof. Experiments on 30 real-world benchmarks across analysis and algebra show that MathEye solves 93.3% of the problems while reducing the number of required user interactions by 55%.
items.title_ko: Sorry에서 QED로: Angelic Execution을 통한 LLM 수학 증명 개선
items.summary_ko: LLM이 생성한 Lean 증명 스크립트가 복잡한 정리에서 실패하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 'MathEye'라는 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이 프레임워크는 불완전한 LLM 생성 스크립트를 상징적 추론과 최소한의 인간 개입을 결합하여 완전히 검증된 Lean 증명으로 변환합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 수학적 추론 능력과 형식 검증 시스템의 통합을 통한 AI의 정확성 향상에 기여하는 연구입니다. AI 기반 수학 증명 도구 개발에 중요한 역할을 할 것입니다.

items.title: EvoDisco: Strategy Discovery for Evolving Agent Memory
items.body: Large language model agents accumulate experience in memory, and how that memory evolves during interaction is as important as what it stores. Recent methods update memory online, yet both the operators that transform memory and the rules that select them remain fixed by design. We propose EvoDisco, which formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery: the agent must discover which operator to apply, when to apply it, and how to instantiate it, rather than rewriting memory under a static operator schedule. A learnable policy conditions on the current memory state and recent task history, then selects and instantiates one of four semantic operators---Abstract, Refine, Bridge, and Reframe---which respectively compress related memories, decompose overloaded entries, connect weakly linked experiences, and reorganize retrieved reasoning chains. The policy is updated with a bi-level fitness. An inner signal scores each transformation using a retrieval-quality improvement regularized by memory complexity. An outer signal scores strategic efficacy over a window of past decisions, combining historical operator-utility regret, utility-prediction error, and selection diversity. Under a one-pass online plus frozen-transfer protocol on ALFWorld, WebShop, and LifelongAgentBench (OS and DB), EvoDisco improves over strong memory baselines including MemP and MemRL. The largest gains are on ALFWorld ($+8.8$ online / $+12.9$ frozen-transfer points over MemP; $+16.4$ / $+17.9$ over MemRL). Ablations attribute these gains to both fitness levels and the operator library.
items.body_ko: 대규모 언어 모델 에이전트는 메모리에 경험을 축적하며, 상호 작용하는 동안 해당 메모리가 어떻게 진화하는지는 저장하는 내용만큼이나 중요합니다. 최근 방법론은 메모리를 온라인으로 업데이트하지만, 메모리를 변환하는 연산자와 이를 선택하는 규칙은 설계상 고정되어 있습니다. 우리는 에이전트 메모리 진화를 진화 전략 발견으로 공식화하는 EvoDisco를 제안합니다. 이는 에이전트가 정적 연산자 스케줄에 따라 메모리를 다시 작성하는 대신, 어떤 연산자를 언제 어떻게 적용할지 발견해야 함을 의미합니다. 학습 가능한 정책은 현재 메모리 상태와 최근 작업 이력을 조건으로 하여 네 가지 의미론적 연산자—Abstract, Refine, Bridge, Reframe—중 하나를 선택하고 인스턴스화합니다. 이 연산자들은 각각 관련 메모리를 압축하고, 과부하된 항목을 분해하며, 약하게 연결된 경험을 연결하고, 검색된 추론 체인을 재구성합니다. 이 정책은 두 가지 수준의 적합성(fitness)으로 업데이트됩니다. 내부 신호는 메모리 복잡성에 의해 정규화된 검색 품질 개선을 사용하여 각 변환에 점수를 매깁니다. 외부 신호는 과거 결정의 일정 기간에 걸친 전략적 효능에 점수를 매기며, 과거 연산자 유틸리티 후회, 유틸리티 예측 오류 및 선택 다양성을 결합합니다. ALFWorld, WebShop 및 LifelongAgentBench (OS 및 DB)에서 원패스 온라인 및 고정 전송 프로토콜을 사용한 결과, EvoDisco는 MemP 및 MemRL을 포함한 강력한 메모리 기준선보다 개선된 성능을 보여줍니다. 가장 큰 개선은 ALFWorld에서 나타났습니다 (MemP 대비 온라인 +8.8 / 고정 전송 +12.9 포인트; MemRL 대비 +16.4 / +17.9 포인트). 절제 연구(Ablations)는 이러한 개선이 두 가지 적합성 수준과 연산자 라이브러리 모두에 기인한다고 분석합니다.
items.title_ko: EvoDisco: 에이전트 메모리 진화를 위한 전략 발견
items.summary_ko: LLM 에이전트가 상호작용 중 경험을 메모리에 축적하고, 이 메모리가 어떻게 진화하는지가 중요함을 강조하며 'EvoDisco'를 제안합니다. 이는 에이전트 메모리 진화를 진화 전략 발견(evolutionary strategy discovery)으로 공식화하여, 메모리 변환 연산자와 적용 규칙을 동적으로 발견하도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 장기 기억 관리 및 학습 능력을 혁신적으로 개선할 수 있는 프레임워크입니다. 지속적으로 학습하고 발전하는 자율 에이전트 개발에 핵심적인 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Semantic Communication via Analog RF Computing: When the Radio Computes the Meaning
items.body: Semantic communication (SC) systems transmit continuous latent representations of meaning, but computing the semantic encoder at resource-constrained edge devices incurs substantial energy and memory costs. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end SC framework that executes the semantic encoder in the client's RF receiver front end using analog RF computing. A base station (BS) broadcasts encoder weights as RF waveforms, while each edge device reuses its receiver's passive mixer to compute semantic latents at ultra-low energy. These latents are transmitted over the uplink for network-side task inference. We show that analog computing noise across encoder layers and channel noise affecting transmitted latents admit a unified mathematical model. We define a task-posterior semantic distortion metric and derive its second-order decomposition into per-client, per-stage semantic sensitivities. Using this decomposition, we obtain a closed-form semantic-aware water-filling allocation of the total client energy budget across clients, encoder layers, and uplinks, assigning tighter accuracy targets to semantically sensitive stages. This allocation induces a broadcast beamforming problem that accounts for client-specific, per-layer accuracy requirements. We further refine the allocation through stochastic optimization and jointly design it with multi-task noise-aware training of the shared semantic model. MNIST simulations show that, at matched total client energy, the proposed allocation reduces network semantic distortion by 9.2\%-19.2\% compared with uniform precision and 5.1\%-13.1\% compared with client-blind allocation. Noise-aware co-design yields a further 46\% reduction.
items.title_ko: 아날로그 RF 컴퓨팅을 통한 의미론적 통신: 라디오가 의미를 계산할 때
items.summary_ko: 의미론적 통신(SC) 시스템은 의미의 연속적인 잠재 표현을 전송하지만, 리소스 제약이 있는 엣지 장치에서 의미론적 인코더를 계산하는 데 상당한 에너지 및 메모리 비용이 발생합니다. 이를 해결하기 위해 아날로그 RF 컴퓨팅을 사용하여 클라이언트의 RF 수신기 프런트 엔드에서 의미론적 인코더를 실행하는 SC 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 엣지 디바이스에서의 AI 연산 효율성을 극대화하는 혁신적인 접근 방식입니다. 저전력, 고효율 AI 통신 시스템 개발에 중요한 기여를 할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Every Measurement, Every Direction, All at Once: Multimodal Flow Matching for Molecules and Spectra
items.body: Generative modeling in science is often data-limited, where experiments are expensive. However, each experiment may yield several coupled measurements of the same physical entity. Standard generative models often train only on a single direction, discarding supervision from the rest. We argue that each experiment contains more training signal than this asymmetry allows the model to exploit: random masking enables measurements to serve as either conditioning inputs or prediction targets, yielding multiple supervised denoising tasks from a single experiment. We investigate this premise with MOSAIC, a multimodal flow matching transformer over molecular 3D structure and UV, IR, and Raman spectra. MOSAIC is a single model that is capable of any-to-any generation: generating any subset of modalities from any disjoint subset of the others. On QM9S, MOSAIC achieves 88.8% molecular graph recovery, outperforming the strongest spectra-to-structure baseline by 23.2% in structure generation, while simultaneously outperforming a structure-to-spectra specialist model in spectral generation. Ablations show that the any-to-any objective improves structure generation over structure-only training across model sizes. Furthermore, MOSAIC supports arbitrary subsets of available measurements and enables molecular identification by matching generated spectra to experimental references.
items.title_ko: 모든 측정, 모든 방향, 한 번에: 분자 및 스펙트럼을 위한 멀티모달 플로우 매칭
items.summary_ko: 과학 분야의 생성 모델링은 데이터가 제한적인 경우가 많습니다. 이 연구는 각 실험이 동일한 물리적 개체에 대한 여러 개의 연결된 측정값을 산출한다는 점을 활용하여, 무작위 마스킹을 통해 측정값이 조건 입력 또는 예측 대상 역할을 모두 수행할 수 있도록 함으로써, 모델이 활용할 수 있는 훈련 신호를 극대화하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 데이터 부족 문제를 겪는 과학 분야에서 생성 모델의 학습 효율을 높이는 효과적인 전략을 제시합니다. 화학, 재료 과학 등에서 새로운 분자나 물질을 설계하는 데 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: When AUC Meets Generative Reconstruction: A Unified Principle for Balanced Visual Representation Learning
items.body: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require visual encoders that extract fine-grained visual features while constructing semantically disentangled and discriminative representations. Conventional methodologies encounter a fundamental trade-off: contrastive learning enhances inter-class discrimination by suppressing intra-class variability, whereas generative reconstruction emphasizes perceptual fidelity but lacks explicit comparative supervision. The naive aggregation of these objectives via composite loss functions often induces optimization conflicts and instability due to gradient interference within the shared latent space. To resolve this, we introduce a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem within the generative output manifold. Our approach maintains perceptual reconstruction as a supervisory signal and integrates a ranking-based discriminative constraint by systematically ordering matched and mismatched reconstruction outputs. This formulation embeds discriminative information seamlessly into the generative process, alleviating the risk of loss competition. Specifically, we propose AUC Generative Reconstruction (AUCGR), which optimizes the area under the ROC curve (AUC) by ensuring higher scores for matched pairs than for mismatched pairs, and Partial AUC Generative Reconstruction (pAUCGR), which addresses supervision bias by focusing on mismatched comparisons within reliable feature subspaces. The proposed objectives are designed to be plug-and-play, requiring no architectural modifications to existing generative reconstruction frameworks. Theoretical analysis establishes rigorous connections to AUC/pAUC optimization and provides generalization guarantees. Extensive experiments validate that our method advances both discriminative accuracy and fine-grained perceptual representation.
items.title_ko: AUC와 생성적 재구성의 만남: 균형 잡힌 시각 표현 학습을 위한 통합 원칙
items.summary_ko: 멀티모달 대규모 언어 모델(MLLM)은 미세한 시각적 특징을 추출하면서도 의미론적으로 분리되고 차별적인 표현을 구성하는 시각 인코더를 필요로 합니다. 이 연구는 대조 학습과 생성적 재구성의 단점을 보완하고 장점을 결합하여 균형 잡힌 시각 표현 학습을 위한 통합 원칙을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: MLLM의 시각적 이해 능력을 향상시키기 위한 표현 학습의 새로운 접근 방식을 제시합니다. 이는 더 강력한 멀티모달 AI 시스템 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: HyCoInfer: Cloud-Edge Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models on Heterogeneous GPU-FPGA Architectures
items.body: Large language model (LLM) serving relies predominantly on cloud GPUs, yet autoregressive decoding is memory-bound and often leaves their arithmetic units underutilized. Edge FPGAs offer attractive decoding efficiency, but are ill suited to sustaining a high-concurrency serving workload alone. This paper presents HyCoInfer, a heterogeneous cloud-edge serving system that assigns prefill to cloud GPUs and distributes decoding across cloud GPUs and edge FPGAs. The design addresses three barriers to practical offloading: capacity balancing across heterogeneous accelerators, the large KV cache crossing a constrained wide-area link, and the latency added by heterogeneous execution. HyCoInfer incorporates FPGA decode capacity into GPU prefill/decode role partitioning and places requests according to queue load, prompt length, and network state. It further combines layer-wise pipelined transfer, decoder-side precomputation, and bandwidth-adaptive KV cache compression based on residual vector quantization. We implement HyCoInfer using two NVIDIA V100 GPUs and an AMD Xilinx Alveo U280 and evaluate it over 100-1000 Mbps links. At 500 Mbps, HyCoInfer delivers up to 4.11 times the request goodput of cloud-only vLLM and reduces mean end-to-end latency by up to 61.1%. Across different network conditions and workloads, the system improves overall serving capacity, with the largest gains on communication-intensive tasks, and reduces per-request energy.
items.title_ko: HyCoInfer: 이기종 GPU-FPGA 아키텍처에서 LLM을 위한 클라우드-엣지 협업 추론
items.summary_ko: LLM 서비스는 주로 클라우드 GPU에 의존하지만, 자동회귀 디코딩은 메모리 바운드입니다. 이 연구는 클라우드 GPU와 엣지 FPGA를 활용하는 이기종 클라우드-엣지 서비스 시스템인 'HyCoInfer'를 제안합니다. 이는 프리필을 클라우드 GPU에 할당하고 디코딩을 클라우드 GPU와 엣지 FPGA에 분산하여 효율성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 효율적인 배포 및 서비스 제공을 위한 클라우드-엣지 컴퓨팅의 새로운 아키텍처를 제시합니다. 고성능 및 저지연 LLM 서비스 개발에 필수적인 기술입니다.

items.title: ATLAS-Finance: Benchmarking AI Agents in Realistic Banking Environments
items.body: Professional work involves under-specified assignments, where relevant information is spread across workplace applications and may conflict or change over time. To evaluate how well frontier agents can perform economically valuable work in such settings, we introduce ATLAS-Finance, a benchmark of 100 end-to-end investment-banking tasks across 13 simulated firms. As in real banking workflows, agents must search email, chat, calendars, notes, and files to identify requirements, gather information, reconcile conflicts/updates, and then build complex financial models. Tasks were developed by experienced bankers based on their real deal work and take them 15-30 hours to complete. Agent deliverables are evaluated with expert-authored rubrics (median: 124.5 criteria) covering financial rationale and results, spreadsheet construction, completeness, and formatting. Despite completing substantial portions of the requested work, current agents rarely produce correct deliverables. Across today's frontier models, the best ones (Claude Opus and Fable) pass fewer than 11% of tasks.
items.body_ko: 전문적인 업무에는 정보가 여러 직장 애플리케이션에 분산되어 있고 시간이 지남에 따라 충돌하거나 변경될 수 있는 불완전하게 지정된 과제가 포함됩니다. 이러한 환경에서 최신 에이전트가 경제적으로 가치 있는 작업을 얼마나 잘 수행할 수 있는지 평가하기 위해, 우리는 13개의 시뮬레이션된 회사에서 100개의 엔드투엔드 투자 은행 업무를 포함하는 벤치마크인 ATLAS-Finance를 소개합니다. 실제 은행 업무 흐름과 마찬가지로 에이전트는 이메일, 채팅, 캘린더, 메모 및 파일을 검색하여 요구 사항을 식별하고, 정보를 수집하고, 충돌/업데이트를 조정하며, 복잡한 재무 모델을 구축해야 합니다. 이 작업들은 숙련된 은행가들이 실제 거래 업무를 바탕으로 개발했으며, 그들이 완료하는 데 15~30시간이 걸립니다. 에이전트의 결과물은 재무적 근거 및 결과, 스프레드시트 구성, 완전성 및 서식을 포함하는 전문가가 작성한 채점 기준(중앙값: 124.5개 기준)으로 평가됩니다. 요청된 작업의 상당 부분을 완료했음에도 불구하고, 현재 에이전트는 올바른 결과물을 거의 생성하지 못합니다. 오늘날의 최신 모델 중에서 가장 뛰어난 모델(Claude Opus 및 Fable)조차도 작업의 11% 미만만을 통과합니다.
items.title_ko: ATLAS-Finance: 현실적인 은행 환경에서 AI 에이전트 벤치마킹
items.summary_ko: ATLAS-Finance는 실제 투자 은행 업무 환경을 시뮬레이션하여 AI 에이전트의 경제적 가치 창출 능력을 평가하는 벤치마크입니다. 13개 가상 회사에서 100가지 종단간 투자 은행 업무를 통해 에이전트가 이메일, 채팅, 캘린더 등 다양한 애플리케이션에서 정보를 탐색하고 요구사항을 식별하도록 요구합니다.
items.why_ko: 현실적인 복잡한 비즈니스 환경에서 AI 에이전트의 성능을 평가하는 중요한 벤치마크입니다. 금융 AI 에이전트 개발자들이 실제 문제를 해결하는 에이전트를 구축하는 데 필요한 지침을 제공합니다.

items.title: When Lower Harm Misleads: Auditing Concept Corrections
items.body: An expert who corrects a concept prediction, such as a BI-RADS descriptor in breast ultrasound, expects the diagnosis to improve. Objectives that reduce the harm of such corrections are judged by harm and accuracy, yet harm also falls when a model responds less to every correction or starts from a worse uncorrected prediction, the reference for harm. We propose a correction audit, a reproducible evaluation protocol that separates these explanations: it splits each correction into harm and useful gain on identical events, separates the starting prediction from the correction response, and compares objectives with amplitude baselines matched in source harm. On three breast-ultrasound sources, worst-case correction training, evaluated from the mean-case model's start, lowers harm but gives up more useful gain in all 21 source comparisons pooled over six seeds, raising the corrected negative log-likelihood (NLL); from the same start, selecting between the objectives by harm picks the less helpful model on all three sources. On CUB, a monotonic harm penalty at its reported weight lowers path-level harm in all 80 concept sets while raising the NLL in all 80, almost entirely before any correction. At a fixed start, rescaling both responses to the same source harm reproduces the penalty's mean harm, useful gain and NLL on single-concept corrections within a prespecified margin of 0.0005 nat, although the two responses point in different directions. Lower harm therefore signals better corrections only when it is read together with useful gain, absolute risk and the start it is measured from.
items.title_ko: 낮은 해로움이 오해를 불러일으킬 때: 개념 교정 감사
items.summary_ko: 유방 초음파의 BI-RADS 기술자와 같은 개념 예측을 전문가가 교정할 때, 진단이 개선될 것으로 기대합니다. 그러나 해로움을 줄이는 목표는 모델이 모든 교정에 덜 반응하거나 교정되지 않은 예측에서 더 나쁜 출발점을 가질 때도 해로움이 감소할 수 있어 오해를 불러일으킬 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 진단 AI의 성능 평가에서 '해로움' 지표의 복잡성을 지적하고, 보다 정확하고 오해의 소지가 없는 평가 프로토콜의 필요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: BernBRS: Certified Backward Reachability for Deep Bernstein Neural Networks
items.body: Ensuring the safety of complex neural network systems requires mathematically rigorous verification. While backward reachability analysis is a critical tool for identifying safe initial states, computing tight, formal bounds remains notoriously difficult to scale. Recent advancements have demonstrated that DeepBern-Nets neural networks utilizing Bernstein polynomial activation functions possess advantageous mathematical properties that enable exceptionally fast and tight forward reachability analysis. Building upon this efficiency, this paper introduces BernBRS, a highly accurate and scalable framework for the backward reachability analysis of DeepBern-Nets. BernBRS simultaneously computes certified inner and outer approximations of the Backward Reachable Set (BRS). Rather than relying on single convex bounding, our method intelligently refines a cover of the input space by analyzing activation patterns, splitting the input domain precisely where an exact decomposition of the relaxation gap predicts the most significant reduction in error. This targeted refinement enables high levels of scalability to highly complex and massive architectures that remain intractable for existing certified methods. We demonstrate the efficacy of our framework on high-dimensional models, including a linearized closed-loop approximation of the Half-Cheetah controller and a distilled Bernstein student of a Transformer block and we empirically study how these model-level guarantees relate to the original Half-Cheetah and TinyBERT classifier, respectively.
items.title_ko: BernBRS: 심층 베른슈타인 신경망을 위한 인증된 역방향 도달 가능성
items.summary_ko: 복잡한 신경망 시스템의 안전을 보장하기 위해 수학적으로 엄격한 검증이 필요합니다. 'BernBRS'는 심층 베른슈타인 신경망(DeepBern-Nets)을 활용하여 안전한 초기 상태를 식별하기 위한 역방향 도달 가능성 분석을 빠르고 정확하게 수행하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 시스템의 안전성 검증 및 신뢰성 확보를 위한 이론적, 계산적 기반을 제공합니다.

items.title: Segmentation-Guided Direct Capacity Estimation of Rooftop Photovoltaics from Aerial Imagery
items.body: Distribution planners need installation-level inventories of rooftop photovoltaic (PV) capacity, but interconnection records may be incomplete or spatially aggregated. Conventional image-based estimators segment PV arrays, convert the mask to physical area, and multiply by an estimated power density, coupling capacity prediction to mask-derived area. We propose Direct Head, a segmentation-guided architecture that retains U-Net segmentation and soft-mask pooling while directly regressing nonnegative capacity from PV-region features and area descriptors. We evaluate three independent runs on 7,590 French rooftop installations under the original split and a department-based holdout. Relative to a parameter-matched area-density neural model, Direct Head reduces mean absolute error by 8.7% and 12.5%, and symmetric mean absolute percentage error by 14.0% and 20.7%, respectively. Comparisons with conventional estimators, controlled architecture variants, auxiliary-loss ablations, and representative cases show that segmentation provides useful spatial evidence without requiring capacity to be determined by an area-density product.
items.title_ko: 항공 이미지에서 세분화 기반 옥상 태양광 발전 용량 직접 추정
items.summary_ko: 배전 계획자들은 옥상 태양광 발전(PV) 용량의 설치 수준 재고가 필요하지만, 상호 연결 기록은 불완전하거나 공간적으로 집계될 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 PV 어레이를 세분화하고 마스크를 물리적 면적으로 변환한 다음, 추정된 전력 밀도를 곱하는 기존 방식과 달리, U-Net 세분화 및 소프트 마스크 풀링을 유지하면서 용량을 직접 회귀하는 'Direct Head' 아키텍처를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 인공위성 또는 드론 이미지를 활용하여 태양광 발전 용량을 정확하게 추정하는 AI 기술은 재생에너지 인프라 계획 및 관리에 중요한 역할을 할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Can You Undo It? Reversibility Classes for AI Agent Actions
items.body: Tool-using AI agents change files, databases, access rights and public information, yet permission to call a tool does not establish whether a mistake can be undone. We present Reversibility Classes, a declared five-level vocabulary with argument-sensitive rules, conservative defaults and an explicit prior-state capture contract. The pinned implementation and evidence-linked registry cover 536 tools across 20 MCP servers. All 738 rule-case checks conform to declared expectations, while native annotation mapping differs from draft registry labels for 118 of 481 comparable tools. One AI-assisted reviewer approves 148 ratings, 75 matching the registry; this is not independent agreement. On 2,158 recorded runs, the implemented session guard gates the associated action in all 29 attributable attack-positive runs, compared with 18 for a read/write proxy, while adding nine approval points across 1,209 benign runs. Controlled file, Git, SQLite and three-browser experiments show that recovery depends on captured state, later changes, editor storage and recovery route, and expose a Git merge-state exception. The evidence supports making recovery assumptions explicit and testable. It does not establish registry-wide accuracy, reduced production harm or general recovery reliability.
items.body_ko: 도구를 사용하는 AI 에이전트는 파일, 데이터베이스, 접근 권한 및 공개 정보를 변경하지만, 도구를 호출할 권한이 실수 복구 가능성을 보장하지는 않습니다. 우리는 선언된 5단계 어휘, 인수에 민감한 규칙, 보수적인 기본값 및 명시적인 이전 상태 캡처 계약을 포함하는 '가역성 클래스(Reversibility Classes)'를 제시합니다. 고정된 구현과 증거 연결 레지스트리는 20개의 MCP 서버에 걸쳐 536개의 도구를 포함합니다. 738개의 규칙-케이스 검사는 모두 선언된 기대치를 준수하는 반면, 기본 주석 매핑은 비교 가능한 481개의 도구 중 118개에서 초안 레지스트리 레이블과 다릅니다. 한 AI 지원 검토자는 148개의 평가를 승인하며, 이 중 75개는 레지스트리와 일치합니다. 이는 독립적인 동의가 아닙니다. 2,158개의 기록된 실행에서, 구현된 세션 가드는 29개의 공격 양성 실행 모두에서 관련 조치를 게이트했으며, 읽기/쓰기 프록시의 경우 18개와 비교됩니다. 또한 1,209개의 무해한 실행에서 9개의 승인 포인트를 추가했습니다. 제어된 파일, Git, SQLite 및 세 가지 브라우저 실험은 복구가 캡처된 상태, 이후 변경 사항, 편집기 저장소 및 복구 경로에 따라 달라지며 Git 병합-상태 예외를 드러냅니다. 이 증거는 복구 가정을 명시적이고 테스트 가능하게 만드는 것을 지지합니다. 이는 레지스트리 전반의 정확성, 생산 피해 감소 또는 일반적인 복구 신뢰성을 입증하지는 않습니다.
items.title_ko: 되돌릴 수 있는가? AI 에이전트 행동을 위한 가역성 클래스
items.summary_ko: 도구를 사용하는 AI 에이전트가 파일, 데이터베이스, 접근 권한 등을 변경할 수 있지만, 실수를 되돌릴 수 있는지 여부는 명확하지 않습니다. 이 연구는 '가역성 클래스(Reversibility Classes)'라는 선언적 5단계 어휘와 인자 민감 규칙, 보수적 기본값, 명시적인 이전 상태 캡처 계약을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 현실 세계에서 행동할 때 발생할 수 있는 오류를 관리하고 복구하는 데 필수적인 실무적 가이드라인을 제공합니다. 개발자들은 이를 통해 더 안전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 에이전트를 설계할 수 있습니다.

items.title: MedGuardBench: A Patient-Oriented Benchmark for Personalized Guardrail Development
items.body: Safety is personal: the same action can be safe for one person but unsafe for another. Yet current guardrails judge content without considering who is affected. Using medication safety, we introduce \textit{patient-conditioned medication guarding}, which predicts a safety verdict and 17 risk categories from a patient profile and prescription. We release \textbf{MedGuardBench}, a drug-disjoint benchmark of 5{,}001 scenarios across 87 medications. We find that standard guardrails rely on surface cues, such as wording and profile presence, rather than patient facts. To address this, we develop \textit{personalized reasoning guardrails} with three components. \textbf{Personalized Reasoning Distillation} links risks to relevant patient fields. \textbf{Context Unrolling (CU)} makes models check each field themselves, reducing false alarms on most backbones; controls show that providing the check does not yield the same benefit. A \textbf{rule-based reward (guided GRPO)} improves unsafe recall and complex-risk detection, including allergies and adverse reactions, on some backbones, but increases false alarms on others. Our models outperform base models and matched no-profile controls in accuracy, while reducing false alarms relative to no-profile controls. Profile removal and swapping confirm that gains come from patient information, not fine-tuning alone.
items.title_ko: MedGuardBench: 개인 맞춤형 가드레일 개발을 위한 환자 중심 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 안전은 개인적인 것이므로 동일한 행동이라도 사람에 따라 안전하거나 위험할 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 환자 프로필과 처방전을 기반으로 안전성 판단과 17가지 위험 범주를 예측하는 '환자 조건부 약물 가드레일'을 소개하고, 'MedGuardBench'라는 벤치마크를 출시합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 시스템의 개인 맞춤형 안전성 평가를 위한 중요한 벤치마크와 접근 방식을 제시합니다. 이는 AI 기반 의료 서비스의 신뢰성과 사용자 맞춤형 안전성을 높이는 데 기여할 것입니다.

items.title: Addressing Exogenous Variability in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) often fails under exogenous variability such as shifts in opponents or environment regimes that cannot be controlled by the team but alter the transition dynamics. We formalize this challenge as Exogenous Dec-POMDP (ED-POMDP), in which an episode-level exogenous regime, selected independently of the team, indexes the dynamics, and the global state is partitioned into components that are directly responsive to the current team action and components that are not directly action-responsive at the current step. This formulation exposes mediated influence: while team actions do not directly update the latter at the current step, they can shape their later evolution through induced changes in the former. Based on this, we propose LEICA, a CTDE-compatible algorithm that learns history-conditioned context representations for both components and shapes policy updates using agent-wise, influence-weighted counterfactual intrinsic rewards. Across SMAX benchmarks with opponent strategy shifts, LEICA consistently improves both training performance and generalization to unseen opponents' strategies over existing baselines, supporting the usefulness of influence-weighted shaping under exogenous train-test regime shifts.
items.title_ko: 협력적 다중 에이전트 강화 학습에서 외생적 변동성 해결
items.summary_ko: 협력적 다중 에이전트 강화 학습(MARL)은 상대방의 변화나 환경 체제 변화와 같은 외생적 변동성으로 인해 성능이 저하되는 경우가 많습니다. 이 연구는 이러한 문제를 '외생적 Dec-POMDP (ED-POMDP)'로 공식화하고 해결 방안을 모색합니다.
items.why_ko: 실제 환경에서 다중 에이전트 시스템이 직면하는 불확실성 문제를 해결하기 위한 중요한 연구입니다. 로봇 군집 제어, 자율주행 등 협력적 AI 시스템 개발에 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Two Counterexamples for e-means
items.body: e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) combines exponential averaging and cluster revival. We give two counterexamples to its published recipe with higher final loss than standard k-means (Lloyd, 1982) from identical initial centers. Mass-based revival can destroy a global optimum and make the ratio of expected losses unbounded even with k-means++ seeding.
items.title_ko: e-means의 두 가지 반례
items.summary_ko: e-means(Bessa et al., 2026)는 지수 이동 평균과 클러스터 재생을 결합한 알고리즘입니다. 이 연구는 e-means의 공개된 레시피에 대한 두 가지 반례를 제시하며, 동일한 초기 중심점에서 표준 k-means보다 더 높은 최종 손실을 보인다고 주장합니다.
items.why_ko: 클러스터링 알고리즘의 이론적 한계를 밝히고, 새로운 알고리즘의 유효성 검증에 대한 중요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: FM-Mamba: An Efficient Native 2D Selective State Space Model with Stability-Aware Discretization
items.body: When applied to two-dimensional features such as images, Mamba-based methods either flatten the feature map into 1D sequences and fuse multiple scans, which breaks spatial adjacency and multiplies computation, or recurse directly on the 2D grid but rescale the recurrence with a fixed input-independent factor and aggregate only the predecessors on a single anti-diagonal, leaving the discrete step unconstrained by 2D stability theory. We propose \textbf{FM-Mamba}, a native 2D selective state space model built on the general Fornasini--Marchesini (FM) model. Its coupled recurrence evolves along both spatial axes; cross-axis coupling induces a discrete diagonal-predecessor term $\tilde A_0$, and two independent input-dependent step sizes $Δ_1(i,j)$, $Δ_2(i,j)$ govern propagation along the two axes, so that the coefficients adapt per position and per direction. A normalized ratio $r_k=a_{0,k}/(a_{1,k}a_{2,k})$ yields a closed-form piecewise bound on the two step sizes; when a configuration falls outside the stable interval the steps are projected onto this bound, and the criterion is re-verified per position after training, which suppresses systematic local amplification without global damping. The recurrence is executed by a dual-diagonal wavefront scan: each update gathers information from two anti-diagonals, and the input enters the current state through a single projection, so that neither training nor inference flattens the feature map. Code is available at https://github.com/BitSsm/FM-Mamba-Runtime
items.title_ko: FM-Mamba: 안정성 인식 이산화를 갖춘 효율적인 Native 2D Selective State Space 모델
items.summary_ko: Mamba 기반 2D 특징 처리 방식의 단점(공간 인접성 파괴, 계산량 증가, 2D 안정성 이론 미고려 등)을 해결하기 위해 'FM-Mamba'라는 Native 2D 선택적 상태 공간 모델을 제안합니다. 이는 안정성 인식 이산화를 통해 효율성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: 이미지와 같은 2D 데이터를 처리하는 Mamba 모델의 효율성과 안정성을 향상시키는 중요한 연구입니다. 컴퓨터 비전 분야에서 새로운 모델 아키텍처 설계에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.body: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.
items.title_ko: 가중치 공간 프로그래밍은 트랜스포머가 필요 없다
items.summary_ko: 가중치 공간 프로그래밍(weight-space programming)은 LLM이 기울기 기반 훈련 없이 신경망 가중치를 직접 작성하는 방식입니다. 이 연구는 이러한 방식에서 표준 트랜스포머 아키텍처를 유지할 필요가 있는지 탐구하며, 세 가지 최첨단 LLM이 고정된 아키텍처의 가중치를 생성하도록 테스트했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 아키텍처 설계에 대한 새로운 관점을 제시하며, 기존 트랜스포머의 제약을 넘어선 새로운 모델 개발 가능성을 열어줍니다. 이는 LLM의 설계 원리와 유연성에 대한 이해를 심화시킵니다.

items.title: A single inference process underlies the behavior and neural circuits of working memory
items.body: Working memory holds past inputs online for future behavior. Despite decades of research, accounts of working memory remain divided across levels of analysis, with long-standing debates on whether its capacity reflects discrete slots or continuous resources, how attention improves recall, and whether its representations rely on persistent neural firing or activity-silent states. Here we show that MemGP, a theory that is specified at the computational, algorithmic, and circuit levels of analysis simultaneously, can explain diverse behavioral and neural phenomena in working memory. At the computational level, MemGP casts working memory as probabilistic inference over a continuous function on feature space, with a variational objective that balances memory strength against a Gaussian-process prior. At the algorithmic level, writing, storing, and reading of memories correspond to approximating this posterior with a finite set of inducing points, the resource that all items share. In simulations, MemGP reproduces load-dependent precision loss, attentional benefits during maintenance, and inter-item attraction and repulsion, in each case revealing multiple complex computational dependencies. At the circuit level, the algorithm analytically (without training) maps onto a recurrent circuit, including its architecture and dynamics. Beyond reproducing neural phenomena such as delay-dependent drift, this analytical map deduces center--surround connectivity, a property long assumed in attractor models, and a structured combination of persistent activity and synaptic weights to hold memories. Thus, a single inference objective not only jointly predicts the behavioral and neural signatures of working memory, but also addresses, across several instances and different levels of analysis, existing competing explanations.
items.title_ko: 단일 추론 프로세스가 작업 기억의 행동 및 신경 회로를 뒷받침한다
items.summary_ko: 작업 기억에 대한 수십 년간의 연구에도 불구하고, 용량이 이산적인 슬롯을 반영하는지, 연속적인 자원을 반영하는지, 주의가 회상을 어떻게 개선하는지 등에 대한 논쟁이 계속되고 있습니다. 이 연구는 MemGP라는 이론이 작업 기억의 행동, 계산, 알고리즘, 회로 수준에서 단일 추론 프로세스를 설명할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 인간의 인지 기능인 작업 기억에 대한 깊이 있는 이해를 제공하며, 이는 인공지능의 인지 모델 설계에도 영감을 줄 수 있습니다.

items.title: RiDEx: Reward-Informed Directional Exploration for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Reward-based diffusion post-training updates model parameters from task rewards. While existing approaches improve sampling and policy optimization, they still rely largely on isotropic random perturbations in a high-dimensional latent space for exploration. Such variation often spends the perturbation budget on changes with little influence on the target reward, making exploration inefficient. We study where diffusion models should explore and how to learn from that exploration. We introduce Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx), which concentrates local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. Conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients propose the subspace, and equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state measure its terminal reward response. The reward difference supplies signed local supervision in the explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute to global DiffusionNFT learning. RiDEx thereby couples exploration-space selection with feedback about the changes it produces. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, RiDEx attains the highest peak rewards among the evaluated methods on four alignment and preference tasks.
